retraction.reason: Retracted in M22: the presidential election of 14 January 1996, won by Jorge Sampaio. Sampaio's ten years matter — the dissolution of 2004 above all — but the atlas holds no record of any of them, so the election that began them has nothing to attach to. This is a retraction that should be reversed as soon as the presidency of 1996 to 2006 is written.
